goal: Extract the cohesive ticket-validation configuration and factory delegation responsibilities from CasConfiguration while preserving its existing public and protected API through delegation methods.

ops.details: Create CasTicketValidatorConfiguration in the same package. Move the ticket-validator methods and defaultTicketValidator state into the extracted class. Keep CasConfiguration methods with their existing signatures and visibility as delegating adapters so existing callers and CasTicketValidatorFactory interactions remain source-compatible. The extracted class should use the existing CasTicketValidatorFactory and CasSecurityConfiguration responsibilities rather than duplicating ticket-validation logic.

Route the existing CasConfiguration ticket-validator methods and default-ticket-validator accessors through a CasTicketValidatorConfiguration instance. Preserve method signatures, visibility, and behavior so external callers do not need to change.
